rows.request: add the exact-final canonical validator without invoking it before the immutable final
rows.failed_witness: the apply-patch tool reported that its presentation output exceeded the available context, so its acknowledgement did not prove whether the complete validator reached EOF
rows.recovery: inspect the named file once, verify its byte length and terminal main guard, and compile its UTF-8 source in memory without executing the validator or repeating the write
rows.bounded_passing_witness: the file existed at 25,696 bytes, ended with the expected main guard, and compiled in memory without creating a canonical receipt or invoking validation
rows.recurrence_guard: after a truncated mutation acknowledgement, inspect the exact target and recover from filesystem evidence before deciding whether any repeat is justified
rows.timestamp_status: read-only recovery recorded after the truncated tool acknowledgement; no fabricated per-command time

rows.request: build and replay the final staged review and exact manifests once from the Git index
rows.failed_witness: the first manifest-builder command crossed the bounded wrapper window after staging its review and the displayed output contained no completion JSON or reusable session receipt
rows.recovery: do not relaunch; inspect the exact Python process, confirm it is the sole intended builder, and monitor its generated files and final process exit
rows.bounded_passing_witness: one intended Python process remained live, produced the owner and delta manifests, exited, and left exactly twenty-five staged additions with zero unstaged or untracked paths
rows.recurrence_guard: long Git-blob replays must preserve the execution-session metadata at the wrapper boundary and monitoring must target the original process rather than starting a duplicate
rows.timestamp_status: single-process recovery completed after the bounded wrapper boundary; no fabricated completion time

rows.bounded_passing_witness: the scalar audit showed one builder process and both manifests, and the subsequent exact-PID wait returned EXITED with twenty-five staged paths and zero unstaged or untracked paths
rows.recurrence_guard: monitoring calls that may outlive a wrapper yield must expose the returned session metadata instead of printing only their partial stdout
rows.timestamp_status: recovery order is exact; no fabricated per-command time
